findings.description: The truthiness check `if fg:` (and likewise `if bg:` at line 684) drops valid color 0, so style(text, fg=0) emits no color code instead of the black ANSI code.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes fg=0 or bg=0, which are valid palette indices. The old `is not None` check emitted \033[38;5;0m. The new truthiness check skips the color entirely. Impact: the styled text silently loses its color with no error.

findings.description: An unknown color name now raises TypeError from style() instead of the previous ValueError, and _interpret_color itself now leaks KeyError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: style(text, fg='notacolor'). The lookup _ansi_colors[color] raises KeyError, which is re-raised as TypeError. Callers or tests that catch ValueError for invalid colors will no longer catch it. Impact: a changed exception type for an invalid-input path.
